issues.description: getCategoryLabel heuristic silently mislabels known category IDs that the deleted explicit table handled correctly.
issues.detail: Replacing the explicit id->label map with regex/length heuristics regresses real inputs: 'trustboundaries' becomes 'Trustboundaries', short real words like 'new'/'log'/'all' get uppercased as if acronyms, and any future ID breaking the pattern fails silently. Restore the explicit table as source of truth and use heuristics only as fallback for unknown IDs.

issues.description: SEVERITY_ORDER adds duplicate-value 'Info' key aliasing 'Informational' without normalization or documentation.
issues.detail: Two distinct strings now denote the same rank, creating a non-injective map that papers over an upstream API inconsistency. Any code sorting or grouping by this map encounters ambiguity. Normalize 'Info' -> 'Informational' at the API boundary instead of carrying both spellings through shared constants.

issues.description: HorizontalBarChart recomputes Math.max inside the per-row .map callback instead of hoisting it.
issues.detail: maxValue is constant across rows but currently recomputed for each item, turning an O(n) render into O(n^2). Hoist maxValue (and total) above the map. The duplicate displayPercentage/calculatedWidth fallback chains should also be lifted into a small derived array so the render stays a pure function of data.

issues.description: CategorySelector uses the string 'all' as a null sentinel, colliding with any future category ID literally named 'all'.
issues.detail: handleValueChange maps '' or 'all' to null because Select rejects empty values. Category IDs come from the API, so a backend-shipped 'all' category would clear state instead of selecting itself. Use a non-colliding reserved sentinel constant or a separate clear control, and make the null-vs-id distinction explicit rather than stringly-typed.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on NEEDS-WORK. The central regression is replacing an explicit category-id->label table with length/regex heuristics in ui/lib/categories.ts — this silently mislabels known IDs like 'trustboundaries' and short real words, and provides no invariant guaranteeing known IDs round-trip. SEVERITY_ORDER's new 'Info' alias for 'Informational' papers over an upstream inconsistency that belongs normalized at the API boundary. Lesser issues: HorizontalBarChart recomputes maxValue inside its row loop, and CategorySelector's 'all' sentinel collides with a possible real category ID. Restore the explicit map, normalize at the edge, hoist the max, and use a non-colliding sentinel.
